name: Grilled Shrimp Tacos with Mango-Avocado Salsa
ingredients: 1 ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Then, lay them out on a paper towel or clean cloth and pat dry. Transfer to a medium bowl. If using fresh shrimp, place them directly into a medium bowl.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the shrimp and transfer the rest to a medium bowl (for the salsa).
Drizzle the shrimp with olive oil and season with chili powder; toss to combine. Set aside while you prepare the salsa.
Peel the mangoes and discard the peels; slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Small dice the mangoes and add to the cilantro.
Halve and pit the avocados; scoop out the flesh from the skin. Small dice the avocados and add to the bowl.
Halve the jalapeños lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Finely dice the peppers and add to the bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl.
Juice the lime and pour over the salsa. Toss the salsa until well combined.
Once the grill pan / skillet is hot, add the shrimp; cook until they are opaque, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and set aside to cool.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel or cloth and microwave until they are heated through, 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Once the shrimp have cooled slightly, peel and discard the tails.
To serve, place 3 to 4 shrimp into each tortilla and spoon the mango-avocado salsa over top. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
